card.name: Drug class names starting with anti-
card.fires_on: The word anti (or Anti) when it begins a drug class name such as antiarrhythmics, anti-seizure or anti-platelet. It usually follows a comma or 'and' in a list of drug classes.

modes.label: Anti in list of classes
modes.description: Anti begins a class name inside a list of drug types.

modes.label: Anti- before hyphenated therapy
modes.description: Anti- is followed by a hyphen and a therapy or condition, such as seizure or platelet.
